# Synthetic sample -- NOT real Huambo data

Five made-up building points and two made-up street lines, coordinates
placed near Huambo city centre only so the demo viewer's default map
extent shows something. Used solely to exercise the pipeline wiring
(street assignment -> numbering -> ID generation -> export) end to end
without depending on real Google Open Buildings / OSM data or network
access.

Replace with a real clipped Huambo extract before treating pipeline
output as meaningful.
